deck_zh: 心里的那一笔、外面的赔偿、发生过的事，需要分开。旁人不能拿一句放下吧，把它们一起销掉。
deck_en: An inward claim, an outstanding remedy, and what happened are different things. Telling someone to move on cannot erase them together.
body_zh: 设想借出去的钱终于还了。朋友说，钱都清了，怎么你见到我还是这样？你也不是想再收一遍钱。只是每次看见他，仍记得那半年怎样等、怎样开口，又怎样担心关系会坏。账面清了，心里还留着另一笔。
这两笔不能混。外面的账，钱、东西、署名、赔偿，可以核，可以追，也可以由主人决定不要。心里的那一笔，是我觉得你仍欠我。宽恕在这里消的是后一笔，而且只是给出这一方自己的。
还有一些，它根本碰不到：别人的账、公家的账、发生过的事，以及对方自己作下的错。我心里的一笔消了，不会使当年的动作变成没有发生，也不会使另一个受损者的那份跟着变成零。
1983年，若望保禄二世到监狱见行刺他的阿贾，公开说重申此前已经给出的宽恕。到2000年，意大利总统另作赦免，教廷声明还说明，教宗赞成宽免的意思，是在意大利法律允许的条件下表达的。
个人的宽恕、国家的刑罚与总统的赦免，不能压成同一个动作。这个区分不需要先评价宗教信仰，也不是一句他原谅了便足以替国家办完后面的事。谁的那份，由谁在相应的位置上处理。
可是，既然是心里的一笔，又怎样不替别人读心？写自己，可以说我消了，或者还没有。写别人，先读他表示过什么，再读他后来有没有拿这一笔要求什么。没有留下的话，不能由一个旁观者替他补全。
所以这篇不会告诉某个人，其实你没有原谅；也不从一次安静的会面宣布，他内心终于自由。本人说宽恕，照录；本人说并不是原谅，也照录。外面没有办法替全部内心颁发证明。
奥斯维辛幸存者伊娃·科尔在1995年宣读过自己的宽恕文书。她后来说明，这是为自己作的事；有人指她代表别的幸存者，她否认。读到这里，可以留下她自己给出的那一头，不把它扩成所有人的决定。
其他幸存者不同意，也不因此低一等。她不能消他们的，他们也不能替她把她的那一份重新立起来。一个人的经历再重，也不自动得到替所有相似经历者签字的资格。
给出与接下，也不是同一头。她若在自己这一边放下了，那一步不等对方回应才算；对方已经去世，也不使她的选择失去位置。消的是自己的那笔，原来就不需要借对方的身体来办。
对方若仍背着自己的那一份，怎样接，是他自己的事。旁人却不能因为他没有回应，就说他仍在自责或根本不在乎。他可能不承认有错，也可能不知道发生过这一项宽恕。沉默没有替我们说明内心。
认错与宽恕也不会彼此收账。对方没有认错，她可以给；对方已经认了，她也可以不给。她是否把某种回应作为自己愿意宽恕的条件，仍由她判断，不反过来成为上一回认错是否发生的唯一关卡。
不原谅，尤其不等于把对方整个人据为一笔债。日本的原田正治在弟弟被杀后，同加害者有过会面，也反对执行死刑。他在访谈中明确说，这不是已经原谅；对那件事的愤怒仍在。
他留下的是几样并在一起的东西：没有原谅，仍看见另一个人，也不愿用他的死来结账。他若不再会面，自己的那笔也仍可以留着，不因此必须把另一个人此后的一切都置于手下。
这里不是拿他的做法作更高的范本，更不替所有受害者决定刑罚。只需这一处区别已经足够：不宽恕，并不自动等于剥掉对方作为人的位置。若非得先原谅，才准停止控制，宽恕便又成了外加的任务。
宽恕与不宽恕，不分高下。不是因为伤害不重，恰恰因为那一笔确实由这个人带着过日子。旁人不能用自己的省事，或希望故事温暖一些，替他决定这时应该消到哪里。
戈登·威尔逊在北爱尔兰爆炸中失去女儿，当晚在广播中为行凶者祈祷，说报复无益。人们称之为宽恕。《爱尔兰传记辞典》却特别指出，他自己没有用这个词；辞典也记下，部分受害者觉得那种榜样让表达悲伤、愤怒变得不被容许。
本人说了什么，旁人怎样把它举起来，是两种动作。他的话可以属于他；你看人家这一句，却会落到别的受损者身上。一个人的做法一旦成了别人的考卷，称赞便不再只在赞那个人。
因此，旁人催不得。都这么多年了、他也道歉了、你该往前走了，这些话没有替当事人承担过那几年，却可能试着替他处置最后还在自己手里的东西。放下不是一件能由围观者催收的债。
有时停手也被叫作宽恕，仍要分。暂不追索，和明确免掉一项自己有权处分的请求，是两回事；两样也都不自动说明心里的那笔消了。一个人可以停下争讼，仍然没有原谅。
2011年，遭泼酸失明的阿梅内·巴赫拉米免去了加害者原被判的同类伤害处分，同时仍明确说要追赔治疗费用。这里读她在当时报导中的表示，不把它写成赔偿已经收到，也不保证后来法律争议怎样了结。
2014年，儿子被杀的萨梅雷·阿里内贾德在执行现场免去那一份，报道也转述了她关于宽恕的话，并写到亲友施加的压力。报道里的译语不能让外人一次验明她全部的内心；但她作的决定，不归催她的人领取。
这两件事里的处分权限来自当时所述的制度安排，不是受损便自然取得私人施罚权。免刑、继续索偿与本人说宽恕，需要分项读；分开它们也不等于认可那些刑罚。这里不把一时一地的规定推广成通则。
不追究，本身仍不足以证明宽恕。也许出于别的判断，也许只是暂时没有做；材料没有说明，就留在没有说明。反过来，没有说宽恕，也不证明心里的那笔一定没消。两边都不靠猜来收尾。
宽恕不是和好。她可以不再见他，也可以不恢复信任。信任要看以后能不能把什么交出去，消掉以前的一笔并没有替未来出具保证；接下来的关系，需要另一段生活去决定。
宽恕也不是不再疼。说过原谅，此后仍难过、仍不愿见，不能仅凭这些便判当初那句话是假的。消掉你欠我，不等于把我疼这一样也删了，更不欠对方一个从此轻松的表情。
后来又觉得欠着，或者改了说法，也有可能。后来那一回另读，不能拿今天抹去昨天说过什么；也不能拿昨天一句宽恕，把今天所有新的表达都挡回去。人不必替一个公众喜欢的结局永久站岗。
这篇没有教人怎样才能宽恕，也没有说怎样才算心理健康。别人的亲身感受可以留下，不变成疗效承诺；一个人需要保护、支持或不再接触的安排，也不以先完成宽恕为条件。
制度的赦免与减刑，怎样处置公家的账，是另一处工作；一个人能不能宽恕自己，也没有在这里答完。承认这些停点，不是让事情无人理，而是不拿心里一笔的名字，把所有需要负责的地方一起撤掉。
开头那位朋友的钱确实还了。你也许有一天不再觉得他欠着，也许没有。这都不使你欠周围人另一份表现。那一笔若要放下，只能在你这里发生；不放下，也不必把他整个人算成赔给你的东西。
body_en: Imagine that a friend finally repays a loan. The money is settled, they say; why are you still distant? You do not want to collect it twice. You remember the months of waiting, asking, and worrying about the relationship. A cleared financial account has left another claim within you.

The two cannot be merged. External claims concern money, objects, credit, and compensation. They can be examined, pursued, or waived by their owners. The inward claim says you still owe me. Forgiveness here releases the latter, and only at the end of the person giving it.

Other things remain beyond its reach: another person's claim, a public claim, the occurrence itself, and the wrong the other actor performed. Releasing something within me cannot make the act unperformed or reset another injured person's account to zero. The same word cannot cancel all those matters together.

In 1983 John Paul II visited his attacker, Ağca, in prison and publicly repeated the forgiveness he had already given. In 2000 an Italian presidential pardon followed separately. The Vatican statement described the pope's support for clemency as conditional upon provision within Italian law.

Personal forgiveness, a criminal sentence, and a presidential pardon are not one act. Recognizing their distinction requires no verdict on religious belief. Nor can saying he forgave complete the state's remaining work. Different powers and claims require their own accounts at the places that actually hold them.

But how can an inward claim be discussed without reading minds? At one's own end, a person can say it has been released or remains. At another's end, read the expression given and any later demands made through that claim. An observer cannot supply everything left unsaid.

This essay consequently will not tell someone that they have not really forgiven, or infer inward freedom from a quiet meeting. A declaration of forgiveness can be recorded. So can an explicit declaration that forgiveness has not occurred. Neither licenses external certification of the whole inward life.

Auschwitz survivor Eva Kor read a personal forgiveness document in 1995. She later described the act as her own, and denied speaking in other survivors' names when accused of doing so. Her stated end can be retained without expanding it into a decision completed for everyone else.

Other survivors could disagree without ranking lower. Their claims were not hers to release, and they could not reinstate her own for her. The gravity of one person's experience does not confer authority to sign for everyone who endured something comparable. Shared history does not merge all its participants.

Giving and receiving likewise occupy different ends. A release made on one's own side need not wait for a response to occur. The other's death need not remove its possibility either. It concerns something carried by the giver, not a procedure requiring possession of the other's body.

If something remains at the other end, receiving belongs there. Silence cannot tell an observer whether self-reproach persists or nothing matters. The person may deny wrongdoing or know nothing of the forgiveness. Neither conclusion can be extracted automatically from an absent reply.

Owning a wrong and forgiveness cannot collect one another. She may give without an admission, or withhold after one. Conditions she chooses for her own willingness remain hers. They do not automatically become the sole examination deciding whether an earlier acknowledgment happened at the other end.

Not forgiving especially need not mean acquiring the whole person as a debt. After his brother's murder, Masaharu Harada met the perpetrator and opposed execution. In an interview he expressly said that this was not forgiveness, and that anger concerning the act remained. The statements coexist.

He had not forgiven, still encountered another human being, and did not want death to settle matters. Had he declined further meetings, his inward claim could also remain without placing the other's entire future at his disposal. Contact is not the price of retaining the distinction.

This does not install Harada as a superior model or determine punishment for every victim. A narrower finding suffices: withholding forgiveness does not automatically remove another's human standing. If forgiveness were required before one could stop controlling, it would have become another externally assigned task.

Forgiving and not forgiving therefore establish no hierarchy here. This is not because the injury was small, but because this person actually carries it. Another's convenience, or desire for a warmer conclusion, cannot decide when the claim must be released. The audience does not own the ending.

After Gordon Wilson lost his daughter in the Enniskillen bombing, he publicly prayed for the bombers and rejected revenge. Others called this forgiveness. The Dictionary of Irish Biography notes that he did not use that term, and records that some victims felt the resulting example inhibited their expression of grief and anger.

What he said and what others made of it are different acts. His words can remain his; the injunction to look at his example lands on somebody else. A person's action becoming another's examination changes the work that praise performs. It no longer concerns only the person being praised.

Bystanders consequently cannot hurry the decision. It has been years, they apologized, you should move on: such sentences need not have carried any of those years. They may nevertheless try to dispose of what remains at the injured end. Letting go is not a debt the audience can collect.

Stopping pursuit also requires distinctions. Deferring a claim differs from expressly waiving something one has authority to release. Neither independently establishes inward forgiveness. Litigation can end while the inner claim remains. A visible cessation is not a transparent window into a person's complete judgment.

In 2011 Ameneh Bahrami, blinded in an acid attack, waived the corresponding injury punishment ordered against her attacker while still stating a demand for treatment costs. This describes the contemporary report. It establishes neither receipt of compensation nor the resolution of later disputes over her legal entitlement.

In 2014 Samereh Alinejad stopped the execution arising from her son's killing. Reports also conveyed her words concerning forgiveness and pressure from family and friends. Translated reporting cannot certify her entire inward state. Her own decision nevertheless cannot be collected by the people urging it.

The authority described in those cases came through the arrangements reported there, not a natural private power to punish acquired through injury. Waiver of punishment, a compensation demand, and expressed forgiveness require separate entries. Distinguishing them endorses neither the penalties nor their extension into universal rules.

Failure to pursue still does not prove forgiveness. Other judgments or temporary inaction may explain it; where records do not say, leave the gap. Conversely, failing to say forgiveness proves no inward retention. Neither side should be completed by an observer's guess merely to finish the story.

Forgiveness is not reconciliation. Someone can release a claim while refusing further meetings or renewed trust. Trust concerns what may safely be entrusted in the future. Releasing an earlier claim provides no guarantee about it. What follows between two people needs further life, not a compulsory narrative arc.

Nor is forgiveness the end of pain. Subsequent sadness or refusal of contact cannot alone prove an earlier declaration false. Releasing you owe me does not erase I hurt. A person owes no permanently relaxed expression to demonstrate that the statement was real.

A later sense of indebtedness or changed statement is also possible. Read the later occasion separately. The present need not erase what was said before, and the earlier sentence cannot prohibit every subsequent expression. Nobody must guard an ending indefinitely because an audience found it satisfying.

No method for achieving forgiveness or test of psychological health is supplied. Personal testimony can remain without becoming a treatment promise. Protection, support, and arrangements ending contact should not require completing forgiveness first. Philosophical distinctions cannot replace the practical help someone may need.

Institutional pardon and reduction of sentence involve other work on public claims. Forgiving oneself also remains unanswered here. Those limits do not abandon the matters. They prevent one inward account from becoming a name under which every other address of responsibility is closed.

The friend really has repaid the money. Perhaps the remaining inward claim will someday go; perhaps it will not. Neither possibility leaves a performance owed to the surrounding audience. Release must occur at your end. Retention need not make the entire other person something awarded to you.

body_hant: 設想借出去的錢終於還了。朋友說，錢都清了，怎麼你見到我還是這樣？你也不是想再收一遍錢。只是每次看見他，仍記得那半年怎樣等、怎樣開口，又怎樣擔心關係會壞。帳面清了，心裡還留著另一筆。
這兩筆不能混。外面的帳，錢、東西、署名、賠償，可以核，可以追，也可以由主人決定不要。心裡的那一筆，是我覺得你仍欠我。寬恕在這裡消的是後一筆，而且只是給出這一方自己的。
還有一些，它根本碰不到：別人的帳、公家的帳、發生過的事，以及對方自己作下的錯。我心裡的一筆消了，不會使當年的動作變成沒有發生，也不會使另一個受損者的那份跟著變成零。
1983年，若望保祿二世到監獄見行刺他的阿賈，公開說重申此前已經給出的寬恕。到2000年，意大利總統另作赦免，教廷聲明還說明，教宗贊成寬免的意思，是在意大利法律允許的條件下表達的。
個人的寬恕、國家的刑罰與總統的赦免，不能壓成同一個動作。這個區分不需要先評價宗教信仰，也不是一句他原諒了便足以替國家辦完後面的事。誰的那份，由誰在相應的位置上處理。
可是，既然是心裡的一筆，又怎樣不替別人讀心？寫自己，可以說我消了，或者還沒有。寫別人，先讀他表示過什麼，再讀他後來有沒有拿這一筆要求什麼。沒有留下的話，不能由一個旁觀者替他補全。
所以這篇不會告訴某個人，其實你沒有原諒；也不從一次安靜的會面宣佈，他內心終於自由。本人說寬恕，照錄；本人說並不是原諒，也照錄。外面沒有辦法替全部內心頒發證明。
奧斯維辛倖存者伊娃·科爾在1995年宣讀過自己的寬恕文書。她後來說明，這是為自己作的事；有人指她代表別的倖存者，她否認。讀到這裡，可以留下她自己給出的那一頭，不把它擴成所有人的決定。
其他倖存者不同意，也不因此低一等。她不能消他們的，他們也不能替她把她的那一份重新立起來。一個人的經歷再重，也不自動得到替所有相似經歷者簽字的資格。
給出與接下，也不是同一頭。她若在自己這一邊放下了，那一步不等對方回應才算；對方已經去世，也不使她的選擇失去位置。消的是自己的那筆，原來就不需要借對方的身體來辦。
對方若仍背著自己的那一份，怎樣接，是他自己的事。旁人卻不能因為他沒有回應，就說他仍在自責或根本不在乎。他可能不承認有錯，也可能不知道發生過這一項寬恕。沉默沒有替我們說明內心。
認錯與寬恕也不會彼此收帳。對方沒有認錯，她可以給；對方已經認了，她也可以不給。她是否把某種回應作為自己願意寬恕的條件，仍由她判斷，不反過來成為上一回認錯是否發生的唯一關卡。
不原諒，尤其不等於把對方整個人據為一筆債。日本的原田正治在弟弟被殺後，同加害者有過會面，也反對執行死刑。他在訪談中明確說，這不是已經原諒；對那件事的憤怒仍在。
他留下的是幾樣並在一起的東西：沒有原諒，仍看見另一個人，也不願用他的死來結帳。他若不再會面，自己的那筆也仍可以留著，不因此必須把另一個人此後的一切都置於手下。
這裡不是拿他的做法作更高的範本，更不替所有受害者決定刑罰。只需這一處區別已經足夠：不寬恕，並不自動等於剝掉對方作為人的位置。若非得先原諒，才准停止控制，寬恕便又成了外加的任務。
寬恕與不寬恕，不分高下。不是因為傷害不重，恰恰因為那一筆確實由這個人帶著過日子。旁人不能用自己的省事，或希望故事溫暖一些，替他決定這時應該消到哪裡。
戈登·威爾遜在北愛爾蘭爆炸中失去女兒，當晚在廣播中為行兇者祈禱，說報復無益。人們稱之為寬恕。《愛爾蘭傳記辭典》卻特別指出，他自己沒有用這個詞；辭典也記下，部分受害者覺得那種榜樣讓表達悲傷、憤怒變得不被容許。
本人說了什麼，旁人怎樣把它舉起來，是兩種動作。他的話可以屬於他；你看人家這一句，卻會落到別的受損者身上。一個人的做法一旦成了別人的考卷，稱讚便不再只在讚那個人。
因此，旁人催不得。都這麼多年了、他也道歉了、你該往前走了，這些話沒有替當事人承擔過那幾年，卻可能試著替他處置最後還在自己手裡的東西。放下不是一件能由圍觀者催收的債。
有時停手也被叫作寬恕，仍要分。暫不追索，和明確免掉一項自己有權處分的請求，是兩回事；兩樣也都不自動說明心裡的那筆消了。一個人可以停下爭訟，仍然沒有原諒。
2011年，遭潑酸失明的阿梅內·巴赫拉米免去了加害者原被判的同類傷害處分，同時仍明確說要追賠治療費用。這裡讀她在當時報導中的表示，不把它寫成賠償已經收到，也不保證後來法律爭議怎樣了結。
2014年，兒子被殺的薩梅雷·阿里內賈德在執行現場免去那一份，報道也轉述了她關於寬恕的話，並寫到親友施加的壓力。報道裡的譯語不能讓外人一次驗明她全部的內心；但她作的決定，不歸催她的人領取。
這兩件事裡的處分權限來自當時所述的制度安排，不是受損便自然取得私人施罰權。免刑、繼續索償與本人說寬恕，需要分項讀；分開它們也不等於認可那些刑罰。這裡不把一時一地的規定推廣成通則。
不追究，本身仍不足以證明寬恕。也許出於別的判斷，也許只是暫時沒有做；材料沒有說明，就留在沒有說明。反過來，沒有說寬恕，也不證明心裡的那筆一定沒消。兩邊都不靠猜來收尾。
寬恕不是和好。她可以不再見他，也可以不恢復信任。信任要看以後能不能把什麼交出去，消掉以前的一筆並沒有替未來出具保證；接下來的關係，需要另一段生活去決定。
寬恕也不是不再疼。說過原諒，此後仍難過、仍不願見，不能僅憑這些便判當初那句話是假的。消掉你欠我，不等於把我疼這一樣也刪了，更不欠對方一個從此輕鬆的表情。
後來又覺得欠著，或者改了說法，也有可能。後來那一回另讀，不能拿今天抹去昨天說過什麼；也不能拿昨天一句寬恕，把今天所有新的表達都擋回去。人不必替一個公眾喜歡的結局永久站崗。
這篇沒有教人怎樣才能寬恕，也沒有說怎樣才算心理健康。別人的親身感受可以留下，不變成療效承諾；一個人需要保護、支持或不再接觸的安排，也不以先完成寬恕為條件。
制度的赦免與減刑，怎樣處置公家的帳，是另一處工作；一個人能不能寬恕自己，也沒有在這裡答完。承認這些停點，不是讓事情無人理，而是不拿心裡一筆的名字，把所有需要負責的地方一起撤掉。
開頭那位朋友的錢確實還了。你也許有一天不再覺得他欠著，也許沒有。這都不使你欠周圍人另一份表現。那一筆若要放下，只能在你這裡發生；不放下，也不必把他整個人算成賠給你的東西。
